[SWS_SM_00664] StateMachine error reaction of StateMachines "ImpactedByUp-
date"
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When ExecutionErrorEvent::executionError is reported from
Platform Health
Management
or from
Execution Management
and the
StateMachine
is "Impact-
edByUpdate" [SWS_SM_00654], the
StateMachine
shall
• ignore the recovery request
• log the event, if logging is activated
⌋
Please note that errors during an update session are notified to
Update
and Configuration Management
via [SWS_SM_00635] for
PrepareUpdate
,
